review_policy: Flagged images were not automatically deleted. Readable and usable images were retained even with imperfect composition, unusual aspect ratio or object-detection failure.
object_detection_role: quality-screening aid only; not proof of car presence, authenticity or usability
limitations: Real-image authenticity was not independently verified for every image.
AI labels and generator identities were inherited from source manifests or folder labels.
Exact historical heuristic thresholds and full per-image V2 audit manifest were not recovered.
The recovered notebook audit code is a documented reconstruction and will not necessarily reproduce the historical 183-item review queue.
